# Camera Settings

> > The Photographer's Field Guide — comprehensive camera settings, calculators, and guides for smartphones (Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra, Google Pixel 9 Pro, iPhone 15 Pro Max) and DSLRs (Canon, Nikon, Sony)

Camera Settings provides practical photography resources including scenario-specific cheat sheets, interactive calculators for astrophotography and long exposure, and detailed guides for flagship smartphone cameras. The site covers techniques from portrait and landscape photography to specialized subjects like aurora and Milky Way photography.

## Key Topics

- RAW format
- Night Mode & Night Photography
- Portrait Mode & Portrait Photography
- Astrophotography & Milky Way
- Long Exposure & ND Filters
- HDR Bracketing
- Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra & S25 Ultra
- Google Pixel 9 Pro & Pixel 8 Pro
- iPhone 15 Pro Max & iPhone 17 Pro
- Canon, Nikon, Sony cameras
- Telephoto Lens techniques
- HEIF image format
- OIS (Optical Image Stabilization)
- Aperture settings
- Camera cheat sheets

## Photography Tools & Calculators

- [Camera Settings — The Photographer's Field Guide](https://camerasettings.com): Photography field guide with tools, calculators, and settings for all cameras
- [Night Sky Planner — Astrophotography Calculator & Guide](https://camerasettings.com/tools/night-sky-photography): Astrophotography planner with NPF rule calculator and Milky Way season guide
- [Long Exposure Calculator — ND Filter Shutter Speed](https://camerasettings.com/tools/long-exposure): ND filter calculator for adjusted shutter speeds with countdown timer

## Smartphone Camera Guides

- [Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra Camera Settings — Best Photo & Video Guide](https://camerasettings.com/guides/samsung-galaxy-s24-ultra-camera-settings): Complete guide for Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra's 200MP camera & 8K video settings
- [Google Pixel 9 Pro Camera Settings — Best Photo & Video Guide](https://camerasettings.com/guides/google-pixel-9-pro-camera-settings): Google Pixel 9 Pro guide with Night Sight, Magic Eraser, and Video Boost
- [iPhone 15 Pro Max Camera Settings — Best Photo & Video Guide](https://camerasettings.com/guides/iphone-15-pro-max-camera-settings): Complete guide for iPhone 15 Pro Max's 48MP camera and 5x telephoto lens
- [iPhone 17 Pro Camera Settings — Best Photo & Video Guide](https://camerasettings.com/guides/iphone-17-pro-camera-settings): iPhone 17 Pro guide with A19 Pro chip, 48MP Fusion, and 4K120 video

## Night & Astrophotography

- [Milky Way Photography Camera Settings Guide](https://camerasettings.com/guides/cheat-sheets/milky-way): Milky Way settings using NPF rule and 500 rule for star photography
- [Aurora Photography Camera Settings Guide](https://camerasettings.com/guides/cheat-sheets/aurora): Northern Lights photography settings using Kp index and night techniques
- [Lightning Camera Settings — Storm Photography Guide](https://camerasettings.com/guides/cheat-sheets/lightning): Lightning storm photography with long exposure and safety techniques

## Portrait Photography

- [Outdoor Portrait Camera Settings — Complete Guide](https://camerasettings.com/guides/cheat-sheets/outdoor-portrait): Natural light portrait photography settings with Eye AF and exposure tips
- [Group Portrait Camera Settings — Multiple People Guide](https://camerasettings.com/guides/cheat-sheets/group-portrait): Group portrait settings for depth of field and multiple people positioning
- [Newborn Camera Settings — Baby Photography Guide](https://camerasettings.com/guides/cheat-sheets/newborn): Safe newborn photography with Eye AF, soft lighting, and silent shutter

## Action & Motion Photography

- [Automotive Camera Settings — Car Photography Guide](https://camerasettings.com/guides/cheat-sheets/automotive): Car photography with CPL filters, light painting, and rolling shot techniques
